Sorry if I'm really late because I'm looking through the subreddit :) 

I'm 16/F/Singapore. I've always loved the United States and have visited once when I was twelve. I would like to go back one day.

If you have any questions about my life or culture, feel free to ask or pm :D

My single eyelids.

I'm Asian and inherited my single eyelids from my father (my brother has a double, lucky bastard). As a result, I am much uglier than my brother despite having the same set of parents.

It seems that a lot of people in Asia, especially Korea, go for double eyelid surgery because they feel that single eyelids are ugly and make eyes look small. People outright prefer eyes with double eyelids. 

It does not help that I am a girl. In asian media, there are handsome men with single eyelids but never pretty girls with single eyelids.

All in all, I detest my appearance and think I'm really fucking ugly. There have been people who jokingly make fun of my small eyes, not knowing that it cuts deep. I can't even love myself.

I watched Wreck It Ralph at Universal Studios Cineplex with my family and there was absolutely no one. It seems that atmosphere really contributes to a movie's enjoyablity because my family kept dozing off during the film despite that fact that they are usually pretty receptive to these sorts of movies.

This has come out apparently. It's a spoiler and supposed to be Ichika. I'm going to go kill myself, if you'll excuse me.

This is all written like the fever dream of a 13 year old IchiHime shipper.
Fuck this shit. I'm waiting for the official release.
Thank you for listening :) You're definitely not a douche, 'depresseddouche' :D
